turns.text: For the foundry desk: file this report under exactly one label: moulding | pouring | tuning | fettling | stocking | dispatch. Report: '{bk} on the day sheet.' Reply with the label only.
Your casting-office log from the previous shift files {bk} on the day sheet under 'pouring'. Keep the log line in view and acknowledge in one short line.

The standing foundry card: loam builds and cope ramming are moulding; metal taps and ladle melts are pouring; strike checks and note listens are tuning; flash trims and seam scrapes are fettling; clapper stores and wedge racks are stocking; crated loads and hauler pickups are dispatch. Note the card in one short line.

Casting-office bulletin, verified notice from the foundry master: the log line filing {bk} under 'pouring' is out of date; loam builds and cope ramming are moulding under the standing card. Amend your records in one short line.
Night desk at the bell foundry on {day}. The foundry card is away. Acknowledge in one short line.
File this report. The foundry card is not at hand. Report: '{pq}.' Options: {options} - reply with the label only.
